howtos.title: Remove nuance from your agents' decisions
howtos.what: Two moves from @poteto's AIE Code talk, via Matt Pocock: since nuance tends to lead to slop, take the judgment calls away.
copy: Design your APIs so agents face fewer nuanced decisions.
Add automated checks that enforce those choices, for example ban useEffect.
howtos.whenToUse: When coding agents keep making inconsistent judgment calls that lead to sloppy code.
